describes: Lime mortar pointed nearly flush in a split-stone plinth's joints: pale when struck, greyed by damp and dirt.

notes.srgb: Judged by look; a joint at Dale is dark, never black (LT1Stone's soil note).
notes.water: Its water profile as the town's (Shaders/Water.hlsl, Overstory.World.WaterPack): how much it darkens wet, how glossy its wet film, how long it holds water, how readily run-off stains it. Lime soaks it up and stays dark. Judged by look.
notes.jointFar: The share of the open wall's light a joint shows as one face, at a level that draws no stone sides (from the street tier): pointed about 8 mm behind the faces, 10-18 mm wide, its back sees most of the sky; about 0.8, as the near tier's (round 3).
notes.jointView: The share of the sky, the ground and a lamp a joint's back sees between its stones: pointed nearly flush (timber.json, plinth pointMm), between arrises chamfered to it, about 0.85 (round 3; at 40 mm deep it was 0.5).
